NOTE
**Still not ready**

Since the feedback, the author pushed one new commit that adds a markdown test case. The screenshots and filled-in description were already there from before the feedback.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | PR description follows the template: "Fixes: #17419", testing steps, before/after screenshots, and a self-review checklist. The issue has "help wanted". |
| ✅  | A regression test case was added in `markdown_test_cases.json`. |
| ❌  | Commits don't follow commit discipline: there are four, including a "fixed linting error" fixup and a separate test commit. None has a proper area-prefixed message such as "markdown: Preserve tab characters in code blocks." |
| ⚠️  | The test commit message says "17418" (wrong issue number). The description also has a typo ("methon"), and the checklist item about adding a test is ticked "as I get a say from reviewer" although no reviewer asked for one. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to clean up the commits; once that's done, this can go to "maintainer review".

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the test and filling in the description! Before we can review, please squash this into a single well-formed commit, with the fix and its test together, a message like "markdown: Preserve tab characters in code blocks.", and no lint-fix commit, following our [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Please also fix the typos in the description.
```
